name: Waldneralm
kurzbeschreibung: Alpine hut at 2,070 m in Prettau in the Ahrntal valley with Brettljausen, typical Ahrntal dishes and panoramic views of the Zillertaler Alpen.
beschreibung:
The Waldneralm is located on the sunny side of the Zillertaler Alpen in the mountain village of Prettau in the Ahrntal valley in South Tyrol. From the hut at around 2,070 metres, guests enjoy a wide view of many three-thousand-metre peaks of the Zillertaler Alpen, the Rieserferner Gruppe and the Hohe Tauern.

The menu features hearty Brettljausen and typical Ahrntal dishes prepared with local specialities. If you wish, you can fish privately in the Waldner See; the permits are available directly at the hut.

The hut lies on the route from Prettau over the Waldner See into the Zillertaler Alpen. Its day of rest is Friday.
